# Line<br />breaks

A Markdown hard break\
inside a paragraph, <u>inside\
a mark</u>, **inside\
bold** and [inside\
a link](https://example.org).

Two breaks\
\
in a row.

A break that ends a paragraph is an element.<br />

<span class="text-red">So is one that ends a mark.<br /></span>

A break before an element is one too:<br /><u>underlined</u> text,<br /><Icon name="star" />

- A list item\
  over two lines
- A list item that ends in a break<br />

### A smaller<br />**heading<br />in bold**

| Cell              | Content                |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- |
| One<br />two      | <u>three<br />four</u> |
| **five<br />six** | seven<br />            |
